scripts.desktop:build: bun build desktop/main.ts --outfile desktop/dist/main.js --target=node --format=esm --external electron && bun build desktop/preload.ts --outfile desktop/dist/preload.cjs --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build desktop/renderer.ts --outfile desktop/dist/renderer.js --target=browser --format=esm && mkdir -p desktop/dist && cp desktop/index.html desktop/styles.css desktop/dist/
scripts.desktop:package: bun run desktop:build && bun run scripts/package-desktop.ts
scripts.test:integration: /bin/sh -c 'docker compose -f test/docker-compose.integration.yml up -d --wait postgres && bun test test/persona-local-postgres.test.ts; status=$?; docker compose -f test/docker-compose.integration.yml down -v; exit $status'
